digest.component_or_area: review-bot auto-deploy and code review flow
propositions: Git fetch timeouts (300s+) during code reviews are misclassified as vote-bearing BLOCK decisions, which then suppress reconciler backfill retries indefinitely
The current 45-second drain timeout is insufficient for reviews that take 260-911s, causing container shutdown mid-review and fail-closed -1 votes that block recovery
Retryable coverage gaps (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled, teardown-mid-review) should cast no vote and defer to reconciler backfill instead of blocking with -1
After N consecutive retryable failures on the same revision (default 3), escalate by casting fail-closed -1 with retries-exhausted note and emitting VOTER_ERROR metric
The review_attempts ledger (keyed by change_id+revision) must record and count deferred attempts separately from the voted table, and support reset via DELETE for manual re-trigger
